items.title: The First Question
items.task: Show the Copenhagen answer. Were you right: completely, partly, not at all? What surprised you instead?

items.title: Your Japan
items.task: Each person: favourite discovery, strangest food, favourite place, favourite photo, favourite myth, biggest surprise.

items.title: Old Japan / New Japan
items.task: Show the Harajuku pair. Which feels more like Japan now?

items.title: What Is Art?
items.task: Show the teamLab line: Tokyo → Kyoto → Osaka. What changed?

items.title: Your Codex
items.task: Look at how many discoveries you hold. Each person picks one Legendary Discovery. Hiroshima stays in Memory, not here.

items.title: The Lost Chronicle
story: War and remembrance. Sacred nature. Mountains. Crafts.
Trains. Manga. Food. Four of you.
items.reveal: Japan wasn't one story. It was all of them.
items.notes: End understated. Then: JAPAN QUEST COMPLETE. No childish fireworks.
